core_ai_not_set_up: AI isn't set up. In Kosha, open Settings › AI, turn on Use AI features and connect a provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
core_ai_no_provider: No AI provider is connected. In Kosha, open Settings › AI and connect one (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
core_ai_off: AI is turned off. In Kosha, open Settings › AI and turn on Use AI features.
core_ai_feature_off: {feature} is turned off. Turn it on in Kosha under Settings › AI › Features.
core_ai_needs_payee: {feature} needs payee names shared, under Settings › AI › What AI can see.
core_ai_needs_amount: {feature} needs amounts shared, under Settings › AI › What AI can see.
core_ai_needs_suggest_category: {feature} needs Suggest a category turned on, under Settings › General.
ai_url_invalid: Enter a full URL, like https://ollama.example.com
ai_url_protocol: Use an http or https URL
ai_url_private: Cloudflare can't reach a local or private address. Use a URL it can reach, such as a Cloudflare Tunnel.
ai_invalid_file: That isn't a file Kosha can read
ai_recap_month_not_over: A recap is written once the month is over
ai_recap_empty: The model didn't write a recap. Try again.
ai_ask_no_answer: The model didn't answer. Try asking another way.
ai_ask_too_many: That took too many look-ups. Try a narrower question.
ai_statement_empty: Couldn't find any transactions in that PDF
ai_layout_unknown: Couldn't work out that file's columns
ai_difference_needs_shares: Finding a difference with AI needs payee names and amounts shared, under Settings › AI › What AI can see.
